page.layout: One printed page, one text column of running text with two woodcut diagrams (a circle with cross lines, and a sphere on a stand); a partly cut-off handwritten marginal annotation on the right edge; a signature line at the foot below the sphere illustration; a catchword-like phrase "Etsi" at the lower right. Website banner at the bottom is not transcribed.

main_text.head: CENTRVM sphaerae est punctum in sphaera medium, à quo omnes rectae ad convexam superficiem eiectae conveniunt longitudine.
main_text.p: POLI ἀπὸ τῆ πολεῖμ, id est, à uertendo dicuntur, latinè uertices & Cardines, & uocantur Puncta axem per sphaerae centrum traiectum terminantia, circa quae sphaera & sphaerae circuli convertuntur.
POLI sphaerae & Circulorum in sphaera descriptorum, sunt puncta in superficie sphaerae consistentia, à quibus omnes rectae lineae ad ambitum Circulorum protensae æquales sunt.

page.notes: The Greek word "ἀπὸ τῆ πολεῖμ" is a probable misprint for ἀπὸ τοῦ πολεῖν; the printed form is kept as far as legible. The marginal handwritten annotations on the right edge (partly cut off, "Super ..." and "uertitur ...") are handwriting and are not transcribed. Several words in the first paragraph are only partly legible and may be misread. The diagram captions and the letters "a" and "b" beside the sphere are handwriting and are omitted.
